items.criterion: FAILIF: release installation leaves VERSION_DEFAULT empty. PROOF: inspect install.sh release wrapper stamping and run the installer regression test.
items.detail: install.sh:1449-1476 stamps VERSION_DEFAULT="<TERMINAL_JAIL_RELEASE_VERSION>" into the checksum-verified wheel wrapper via awk (awk -v tj_ver, no program-text interpolation) after the shebang/shape checks, with a fail-closed gate at install.sh:1459-1463 refusing a wheel whose wrapper lost the stampable line. Live smoke with a wheel bundling the REAL standalone/terminal-jail (/tmp/tjdf076-rel.ypWhaG): log shows 'checksum OK (terminal_jail-1.3.4-py3-none-any.whl)' then 'stamped release version 1.3.4 into the installed wrapper'; installed binary line 92 reads VERSION_DEFAULT="1.3.4" and `env -i ... terminal-jail --version` prints 'terminal-jail 1.3.4' (previously empty). Tests fresh-run: the four new regressions test_release_mode_install_stamps_the_chosen_release_version / accepts_a_v_prefixed... / refuses_an_unsafe_version... / refuses_a_wheel_without_a_stampable_wrapper all PASSED, exit 0, '4 passed in 1.31s'; full installer suite plugin/test_install.py exit 0 '109 passed, 1 skipped in 118.03s'; tier1 suite 2231 passed/15 skipped. [resolution 0.18; install.sh]

items.criterion: FAILIF: absolute-path release install regresses. PROOF: run the TJ-GAP-087 installer tests.
items.detail: TJ-GAP-087 installer tests fresh-run: test_release_mode_requires_opt_in, test_install_reports_both_probes_advisory, test_advisory_missing_probe_is_one_honest_line, test_require_tier_pidns_fails_closed_on_degraded all PASSED, exit 0, '4 passed in 0.36s'. The new stamp does not alter the absolute-path contract: install.sh:489-505 keeps USE_RELEASE=1 suppressing checkout resolution, and the stamp block keys off LOCAL_WRAPPER emptiness (the same release-mode predicate). Live check of the exact TJ-GAP-087 shape: from a foreign cwd, `/bin/sh /home/kara/worktrees/terminal-jail-TJ-DF-076/install.sh` with TERMINAL_JAIL_USE_RELEASE=1 installed the checksum-verified release wrapper stamped 1.3.4 (VERSION_DEFAULT="1.3.4" at line 92, --version clean-env output 'terminal-jail 1.3.4'); 'v1.3.4' selection also stamped the stripped '1.3.4'.

items.criterion: Release stamp consumes the same version variable the release download used (seam: chosen wheel version == stamped version)
items.detail: install.sh:1367 builds release_asset='terminal_jail-${TERMINAL_JAIL_RELEASE_VERSION}-py3-none-any.whl' and install.sh:1471 stamps awk -v tj_ver="$TERMINAL_JAIL_RELEASE_VERSION" — one variable, no drift. The regression test installs a non-pin wheel (chosen 9.9.9 vs installer pin 1.3.4) and asserts installed --version equals 9.9.9 (plugin/test_install.py:494-501 assertion), PASSED.

items.criterion: The caller-supplied version is shape-checked before any splice (no injection/broken-wrapper surface)
items.detail: install.sh:26-33 parse-time case "$TERMINAL_JAIL_RELEASE_VERSION" in "" | *[!0-9A-Za-z._+-]*) exit 1 — quotes, sed metacharacters and newlines are outside the charset, before anything is downloaded or written. Live shell probe with TERMINAL_JAIL_VERSION='9.9.9"; touch /tmp/tjdf076-injected; #' exited 1 with the named refusal and no injected marker file and no install dir created. Regression test test_release_mode_refuses_an_unsafe_version_before_anything_is_written PASSED. (scan_security unavailable — ast-grep not installed — compensated by this live probe.)

items.criterion: The stamp runs only after checksum verification (integrity gate preserved)
items.detail: install.sh:1381-1404 computes and verifies the SHA256SUMS entry (exit 1 on mismatch) BEFORE the stamp block at 1449; the smoke log shows the 'checksum OK' line preceding the 'stamped release version' line, and the regression test asserts 'checksum OK (terminal_jail-9.9.9-py3-none-any.whl)' appears in output (plugin/test_install.py:477-479), PASSED.

items.criterion: Checkout-mode install keeps its existing stamping behaviour (back-compat)
items.detail: The checkout branch is untouched: install.sh:1226 still sed-stamps VERSION_DEFAULT from pyproject.toml (LOCAL_VERSION). Live smoke without USE_RELEASE (absolute path, /tmp/tjdf076-smoke.t3JMwC): log line 'repository checkout detected — installing local wrapper (…/standalone/terminal-jail, version 1.3.4)', installed --version printed 'terminal-jail 1.3.4'. plugin/test_install.py suite (109 passed) and plugin/test_version_parity.py+tests/test_version.py+tests/test_release_workflow.py (25 passed) confirm no regression.

items.criterion: The stamp temp file is cleaned up (no partial-artifact or temp residue)
items.detail: install.sh:1192 defines tmp_stamped=.terminal-jail.$$.stamped and the cleanup() trap at install.sh:1194-1197 rm's it alongside tmp_payload/tmp_wheel/tmp_checksum; the stamp writes to tmp_stamped then mv -f over tmp_payload (install.sh:1474-1475). Live release smoke: install-dir contains only 'terminal-jail' — no .terminal-jail.* residue; the pre-existing test_tmp_files_cleaned_after_install PASSED in the 109-test suite run.
